summary.text: Margaret Scarsdale is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Middlesex District who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator by profession, she has also owned a writing and consulting business.

paragraphs.text: Margaret Scarsdale was born in Georgia and lives in Massachusetts, according to Ballotpedia.
She earned a general equivalency diploma and later a bachelor's degree in American studies and sociology.
Her career experience includes owning a writing and consulting business, working at Ayer Town Hall, and teaching language arts.
Scarsdale assumed office on January 4, 2023, succeeding Republican Sheila Harrington.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to joint committees including Aging and Independence; Environment, Natural Resources and Agriculture; and Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
